entries.title: Carney calls Trump's fresh tariffs a 'miscalculation' after trade talks collapse
entries.snippet: Canada's prime minister said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs as he accused the US of starting a trade war.

entries.title: Carney faces crucial test after walking away from Trump's deal
entries.snippet: The Canadian prime minister will have to sell his gamble that walking away from talks with the White House will be worth the consequences.

entries.title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
entries.snippet: Four people are still missing after Friday's attack which killed 16 and left 130 injured, including a number of children.

entries.title: Father leaves 7-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue hike
entries.snippet: The man had taken his two boys on the trip but is said to have left one behind when he got tired.

entries.title: Syria says Israeli strike near Damascus violation of international law
entries.snippet: The latest incident comes days after reports emerged Israel had struck a military airbase close to the Turkish border.

entries.title: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
entries.snippet: The deal stems from a 2024 lawsuit alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.

entries.title: Fourteen killed in strike on Myanmar monastery
entries.snippet: A rescue worker said the site had been struck twice as civilians gathered for a meditation retreat.

entries.title: US military newspaper editor voices censorship fears after being fired
entries.snippet: Erik Slavin believes he was fired for saying in an interview that "in a hypothetical situation, censorship would be a red line".

entries.title: Sydney Marathon medal mistakenly depicts Munich stadium
entries.snippet: Online sleuths detected the error after Sydney Marathon unveiled the double-sided medal.

entries.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
entries.snippet: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.

entries.title: One killed in sword attack at Swedish school
entries.snippet: Officials say another three people were injured, and an 18-year-old male suspect shot and arrested.

entries.title: Lindsay Clancy suffering 'command hallucination' when she killed children, court hears
entries.snippet: The defence brought their final witness - a forensic psychiatrist - to the stand to testify about the effects of postpartum psychosis.

entries.title: UK, Canada and Australia condemn Israel for refusing criminal probe into aid worker killings in Gaza
entries.snippet: Seven World Central Kitchen workers were killed in the Israeli strike on their convoy in 2024.

entries.title: Two injured in stabbing attack at Canada Sikh temple
entries.snippet: One suspect is in custody, and police have said they are still investigating if the attack was motivated by hate.

entries.title: As they return to the UK, Harry and Meghan search for a brand that sticks
entries.snippet: They will not be working royals when they come back. So what could they be doing instead?

entries.title: The hotel booking mix-up that could free mushroom murderer
entries.snippet: A table tennis tournament and a throat lozenge could help Erin Patterson's lawyers overturn her convictions.

entries.title: These bookshops let Chinese readers question their country - now the doors are closing
entries.snippet: For some mainlanders, Hong Kong's independent bookstores are a window into a different, freer world.

entries.title: Drugs at their fingertips, intense pressure: Why child stars fall into addiction
entries.snippet: Experts told the BBC the pressures of childhood stardom can put actors at an unusually higher risk of substance abuse issues.

entries.title: How Israel is expanding settlements in drive to reshape West Bank
entries.snippet: There has been a significant expansion of building and road construction on Palestinian land occupied by Israel in recent years.

entries.title: Modi spent years building his strong image - why is he making Gen Z reels now?
entries.snippet: Narendra Modi's new, more casual online persona is drawing attention from young Indians - but also plenty of scepticism.

entries.title: Trump administration's 75-country visa ban was illegal, judge rules
entries.snippet: The U.S. stopped issuing visas for citizens of 75 countries because it said they were likely to need public assistance. A judge ruled the policy illegally discriminated on the basis of nationality.

entries.title: Opinion: Mr. Rogers keeps finding a new neighborhood
entries.snippet: MLB catcher Jake Rogers probably didn't know if he was coming or going the last several weeks: he's been a Detroit Tiger, a Baltimore Oriole, a Boston Red Sox, and now he's a Chicago White Sox.

entries.title: As Flock battles public scrutiny, other police surveillance companies see an opening
entries.snippet: Dozens of cities have canceled their contracts with Flock. Some are switching to other companies, but privacy experts say they're no better than Flock.

entries.title: Hours after U.S. imposes tariffs, Canada says it'll strike back starting Sept. 8
entries.snippet: The U.S. has now imposed 50% tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian products. Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canada will match those tariffs "dollar for dollar" next month.

entries.title: A battle over 'Italian brainrot' could shape who owns AI art
entries.snippet: A legal battle over what looks like a cartoon stick could help set the rules over whether creators can claim ownership of their AI-generated characters.

entries.title: Supreme Court allows Trump's ballroom construction to continue for now
entries.snippet: The ruling comes after months of back-and-forth between the Trump administration and the National Trust for Historic Preservation.

entries.title: Beatty files emergency request to stop Trump's name from returning to Kennedy Center
entries.snippet: Joyce Beatty, a Democratic representative from Ohio, asked a federal judge to stop the Kennedy Center trustees from putting President Trump's name up in three places at the arts complex.

entries.title: Top Iran official says U.S. focus on economic warfare shows it has failed militarily
entries.snippet: The Iranian regime has dismissed President Trump's threats to crush Iran economically, saying that years of U.S. sanctions have failed.

entries.title: Trump declares economic warfare on Iran. And, SCOTUS to rule on White House ballroom
entries.snippet: President Trump has declared economic warfare on Iran in an effort to pressure the country back into negotiations. And, the Supreme Court is set to decide on the future of Trump's ballroom.

entries.title: What to know about this weekend's IndyCar race on the National Mall
entries.snippet: Why is the car race in this part of D.C.? Will it be streaming? Who's paying for it? Here's what to know before the Freedom 250 Grand Prix hits the National Mall this weekend.

entries.title: What to know about Trump's 50% tariffs on Canadian goods that just went into effect
entries.snippet: The new levies are expected to affect about 5% of Canada's annual exports to the U.S., roughly $20 billion in goods ranging from hockey sticks to agricultural products.

entries.title: Enriched uranium stockpile undercuts Trump claim of Iran's 'essential denuclearization'
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump said he has presided over "the essential denuclearization of Iran." But Iran likely still has materials and machinery that can be used to make nuclear weapons, undercutting Trump's claim.

entries.title: Tropical Storm Moke advances toward Hawaii as winds strengthen
entries.snippet: As with Hurricane Lala, the Big Island is expected to bear the brunt of Moke's rain and heavy winds as it passes south of a direct hit late Saturday into early Sunday.

entries.title: This rare Nebraska district backed Harris but sent a Republican to Congress. Can Democrats win here?
entries.snippet: Retiring Rep. Don Bacon's open seat pits fellow Republican and Omaha City Councilmember Brinker Harding against Democratic activist Denise Powell.

entries.title: Trump threatens lawsuit against nonprofit that questioned whether National Guard plan lessened crime
entries.snippet: The letter gave the Washington, D.C.-based Center for American Progress until the end of business Friday to issue the retraction or face a $5 billion lawsuit. The center declined.

entries.title: Student killed in sword attack at a Swedish school was a 17-year-old girl
entries.snippet: An 18-year-old man armed with a sword carried out the attack at the Brinell School in Fagersta, northwest of Stockholm, while classes were in session on Friday. One person was killed and three others were wounded, two of them severely.

entries.title: TikTok reaches $400 million settlement with Justice Department over children's privacy
entries.snippet: The DOJ said Friday that TikTok will pay $300 million immediately and another $100 million after an order vacates an earlier consent decree against its predecessor company, Musical.ly.

entries.title: Federal judge vacates Trump policy that suspended processing of immigration visas from 75 countries
entries.snippet: The judge ruled that Secretary of State Marco Rubio exceeded his authority by issuing the policy, which "runs afoul" of the Immigration and Nationality Act by mandating "the refusal of visas to eligible applicants without any basis in law."

entries.title: Federal officials announce water cuts as Colorado River supplies continue to plunge
entries.snippet: Under the Bureau of Reclamation's plan, California, Nevada and Arizona will collectively reduce water use by 1.25 million acre-feet annually for the next two years, with the possibility of larger cuts depending on conditions.

entries.title: U.S. and Canada fall deeper into a trade war with new tariffs as talks collapse and blame is spread
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump's import taxes will hit about 5% of what Canada ships to the United States every year, including products ranging from hockey sticks to tongue depressors.

entries.title: Stars and Stripes editor, reporter fired for insubordination after doing CBS interview
entries.snippet: The Pentagon on Friday fired the editor-in-chief of Stars and Stripes and a top reporter for insubordination after they spoke publicly against any interference by the Defense Department in the military news outlet that has a long history of editorial independence.

entries.title: From White House ballroom to IndyCar race, Trump's spectacles take center stage in D.C.
entries.snippet: The Supreme Court temporarily cleared the way for construction of President Trump's White House ballroom to continue while the justices consider his administration's appeal. White House correspondent Liz Landers reports on the ballroom as well as the president's IndyCar race comi

entries.title: News Wrap: Defense rests in murder trial of Lindsay Clancy
entries.snippet: In our news wrap Friday, the defense rested its case in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, the editor-in-chief of Stars and Stripes says the Pentagon has fired him and President Trump paused on ground beef tariffs in an attempt to lower prices.

entries.title: Paramount's Warner Bros. bid and threat to leave California divide Hollywood
entries.snippet: The proposed $111 billion merger between Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery hit a roadblock after California's attorney general and 11 other states sued to stop it. That move was followed by Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison threatening to take his operations out of Californ

entries.title: U.S. ambassador responds to rising tensions between Israel, Turkey and Syria
entries.snippet: The Israeli military bombed an airbase in Syria, far from the Israeli border, sparking condemnation not only from Syria, but also Turkey and the Trump administration. U.S. Ambassador to Turkey Tom Barrack accused Israel of an "unnecessary escalation that does not advance regional

entries.title: Brooks and Capehart on how economic concerns defined the primaries
entries.snippet: David Brooks of The Atlantic and Jonathan Capehart of MS NOW join Amna Nawaz to discuss the week in politics, including this week's midterm primary results, the economy taking center stage, President Trump lashing out at key allies and the controversy surrounding a Trump aide.

entries.title: U.S. Forest Service, timber companies spraying record amounts of glyphosate in California
entries.snippet: An investigation by the Center for Investigative Reporting has revealed that glyphosate is being sprayed in California forests at record levels by timber companies and the U.S. Forest Service. Glyphosate, the active ingredient in Roundup, kills vegetation that competes with young

entries.title: Poorna Jagannathan and Amna Nawaz discuss representation in Hollywood on 'Settle In'
entries.snippet: Award-winning actress Poorna Jagannathan is known for her roles in the Netflix coming-of-age series "Never Have I Ever" and the Hulu crime dramedy "Deli Boys." Jagannathan joined Amna Nawaz on our PBS News podcast "Settle In" and discussed Hollywood's ongoing struggle with divers

entries.title: Arizona AG declines to charge Gov. Katie Hobbs over pay-to-play allegations
entries.snippet: State prosecutors declined to file criminal charges over allegations that she took part in a pay-to-play scheme with a group home company that received a rate increase from the state after contributing $100,000 to her inaugural celebration.

entries.title: Supreme Court chief justice allows work on Trump's $400M White House ballroom to continue for now
entries.snippet: The temporary order comes hours before lower-court rulings would have forced a halt to aboveground construction.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Cargo vessel sinks off Indian coast
entries.snippet: The Panama‑flagged Ocean Winner reportedly had a crew of 24, at least two of whom appear to have been rescued. The ship is thought to have been carrying iron ore from India to Singapore.

entries.title: Nigeria: Jihadis kidnap dozens during Friday prayers
entries.snippet: Witnesses said men carrying guns and machetes set upon two villages in Niger State. Many details about the attack have yet to be confirmed by police.

entries.title: Germany news: Friedrich Merz visits area struck by fires
entries.snippet: Chancellor Merz thanked firefighters who tackled recent devastating blazes in western Germany. Meanwhile, a German Cup soccer match ended in a mass brawl with over 100 injuries. DW has more.

entries.title: Kazakhstan's future after the elections: Russia, EU or China
entries.snippet: Kazakhstan, where power is being continuously consolidated in the president's hands, will have to continue its tough balancing act between the EU, Russia and China following the parliamentary elections this Sunday.

entries.title: Spain battles forest fire a short drive from flash flood
entries.snippet: The blaze, near Valencia, forced more than 1,000 people from their homes. In nearby Catalonia, civil defense teams carried out 200 rescue operations after floods trapped residents in cars and homes.

entries.title: Chinese robot beats Usain Bolt's 100m world record
entries.snippet: The Chinese humanoid robot "Lightning" ran a 100-meter trial race faster than human world-record holder Usain Bolt. A year ago, humanoid robots struggled to finish a race.

entries.title: Myanmar military airstrike kills 14 at Buddhist monastery: reports
entries.snippet: Around 100 people were attending a meditation retreat in central Myanmar when the building was targeted by military planes, witnesses said.

entries.title: Small German airplane crashes in Croatia, killing 2
entries.snippet: The two-seater motor glider went down in the Velebit mountains, near Zadar, killing both passengers.

entries.title: India news: Gandhi's handwritten notes sold for $1.7 million at Mumbai auction
entries.snippet: A collection of notes written by Mahatma Gandhi has fetched the highest ever price for an Indian historical document in Mumbai. Meanwhile, a reported visit by Bangladesh's Tarique Rahman remains in doubt. DW has more.

entries.title: Ukraine: Russia steps up attacks as German Foreign Minister Johan Wadephul visits Kyiv
entries.snippet: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul has traveled to Kyiv ahead of Ukraine's 35th Independence Day. A Russian missile attack killed at least 2 people as Wadephul met with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

entries.title: Germany investigates arms cache found in woods near Berlin
entries.snippet: Handguns and ammunition were found in a forest near Berlin last year. Reports say German authorities suspect they were to be used for assassinations on behalf of Russian intelligence.

entries.title: Industry and residents clash over water near Berlin
entries.snippet: The state surrounding Berlin is drying out, but local Tesla and Red Bull plants are looking to expand. Is Brandenburg running out of water to share?

entries.title: Pentagon fires military newspaper leadership for 'insubordination'
entries.snippet: The editor-in-chief of Stars and Stripes said he was fired, alongside the newspaper's publisher and a reporter, for insubordination after he objected to potential editorial interference.

entries.title: US imposes 50% tariffs on some Canadian products as trade talks fail
entries.snippet: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Canada had declined to finalize a trade deal, minutes before fresh Trump tariffs were due to take effect. Canada's Mark Carney said the terms proposed were "unfair."

entries.title: TikTok agrees to pay $400m to settle US children's privacy case
entries.snippet: The US Justice Department sued TikTok in 2024 over allegations that it violated children's online privacy laws. The settlement is believed to be one of the largest ever over the issue.

entries.title: Sweden: One killed in school sword attack
entries.snippet: Police have said they have arrested an individual who stabbed several people, killing one person, with a sword at a high school in central Sweden.

entries.title: 'Masha and the Bear': Ukraine sanctions Russian cartoon
entries.snippet: Ukraine has imposed sanctions on the hit Russian children's cartoon "Masha and the Bear," a step towards banning it. The culture minister called the show propaganda. Russia said the move showed Kyiv's "ugly nature."

entries.title: German army helps Poland protect itself against Russia
entries.snippet: Poland is building a defense system along its northern and eastern borders to protect itself from Russia. Since June, German sappers have been assisting their NATO ally with the construction of the East Shield.

entries.title: France issues warning over thousands of substandard condoms
entries.snippet: French anti-fraud and health agencies have issued a recall order for roughly 260,000 condoms. They advised users to consider sexually transmitted infection and pregnancy tests amid risks of bursting or perforations.
